objects.description: [VajraSpy](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9006) has recorded surrounding audio and phone calls from WhatsApp, WhatsApp Business, Signal, and Telegram by requesting `android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO`.(Citation: ESET_VajraSpy_Feb2024)(Citation: K7Dhanalakshmi_VajraSpy_April2022)
objects.description_fa: [VajraSpy](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9006) تماس‌های صوتی و تلفنی اطراف را از WhatsApp، WhatsApp Business، سیگنال، و تلگرام با درخواست «android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO» ضبط کرده است.(Citation: ESET_VajraSpy_Feb2024)[[[CTI_PRESERVE_1]] (Citation: K7Dhanalakshmi_VajraSpy_April2022)
